about: Homework for this pillar, one list per AI (Claude writes it; tools/kit/render.py in jpavia10/prometheus-hub turns it into docs/agents/QUEUE_{ai}.md and the Drive docs). Every task says exactly what to read, what to make, how many, where to save it, how Claude checks it and what makes it not done. A task is done only when the file passes the checks, never because it was sent.

tasks.title: Hermes Post: the spec sheet (mail and messages: what came in, what needs an answer, what is a bill (Gmail for Joseph and for Sylade))
tasks.why: Hermes Post is a seat on the desk with no page yet. Joseph wants each pillar developed on its own; the first step is a spec Claude can build from.
steps: Write the spec for Hermes Post: mail and messages: what came in, what needs an answer, what is a bill (Gmail for Joseph and for Sylade).
At least 6 data sources with their real API names and documentation URLs (open each one); say plainly when something has no public API.
Four first screens, each listing every number on it and where it comes from.
Five 'done when' checks that can be tested on a phone.
No message text ever goes into the repo or Drive docs; only counts and labels on the page.

deliver.shape: one markdown file with these 6 headings, in this order: 1 Purpose (one sentence) | 2 Data sources (a table: source | what it gives | how to get it (API name) | docs URL | sign-in type | cost | limits) | 3 First four screens (for each: its name, every number and list on it, where each comes from) | 4 Version 1 done when (5 checks Claude can test) | 5 Privacy (what never leaves the device) | 6 What Joseph must do once (accounts, keys, apps)

tasks.done_when: All 6 headings, at least 6 sources with working docs URLs, 4 screens, 5 testable checks.
checks: Claude checks each 'done when' can be tested without asking Joseph.
rejected_if: a row copied from another row with the names changed
a source URL that does not open or does not say what the row claims
fewer items than the count
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
an API that does not exist or a docs URL for something else
a screen that lists a number with no source

tasks.title: 60 US billers: the address their bill emails come from
tasks.why: Hermes sorts bills from the rest; knowing each biller's sending domain (from its own help page) makes the rule exact.
steps: 60 billers (power, gas, water, internet, mobile, streaming, car and home insurance, the 25 card issuers in MID-GEM-04, student loans, car loans).
From each company's own help or security page ('our emails come from ...'): the sending domains, the usual subject words for a bill, the help URL and the quote.
tasks.done_when: 60 billers, every domain quoted from the company's own page.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a domain guessed from a company name
anything about Joseph's own accounts, balances, mail, messages or trades (public facts only)

tasks.title: Every Gmail search operator, with syntax and one example each
tasks.why: Hermes rules are written as Gmail searches.
steps: Open https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7190 and copy every operator on it (there are about 40), exactly as written, with what it does and one example of your own.
tasks.done_when: Every operator on the page (Claude counts the page).
checks: Claude compares the list with the page; a missing operator or an invented one fails the file.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
an operator that is not on that page

tasks.title: 30 phishing tells from FTC, CISA and Google, quoted
tasks.why: Hermes should flag a fake bill before Joseph pays it.
steps: 30 tells (sender domain lookalike, urgent payment threat, gift-card ask, reply-to differs, link text differs from link target, ...), each from consumer.ftc.gov, cisa.gov or support.google.com.
For each: the tell, a test Hermes can run on a message (headers or body), the URL and the quote.

deliver.shape: [{"n":1,"tell":"the reply-to address differs from the sender","test":"header Reply-To domain != From domain","url":"https://consumer.ftc.gov/...","quote":"..."}]

tasks.done_when: 30 tells, each with a test written over headers or body.
checks: A test that is only 'looks suspicious' does not count.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name

tasks.title: Triage test set: 80 made-up emails, 20 per lane
tasks.why: Claude tests Hermes's sorting on mail that is not Joseph's.
steps: Write 80 made-up emails: 20 'needs an answer', 20 'bill due in 7 days', 20 'waiting on others', 20 'read later'. Include 10 hard ones per lane (a bill that looks like news, a question buried in a newsletter, a reminder that is only an ad).
Every sender uses an example.com, example.org or example.net address; no real person, no real company address.
For each: from, subject, date (2026-11), the first 3 lines of the body, the lane, and one sentence why.
checks: Claude counts lanes and checks every address is example.com/.org/.net.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a real address or a real person's name
anything about Joseph's own accounts, balances, mail, messages or trades (public facts only)

tasks.title: Hermes Post: second reader on Gemini's spec
tasks.why: Every source in a spec gets a second reader before Claude builds on it.
inputs: Gemini's file hermes_gemini_spec_*.md in the incoming folder (once it is there)
steps: Open every data source's docs URL; for each write: source, Gemini's claim (sign-in, cost, limits), what the page says, agree/differ.
Add up to 5 sources Gemini missed, same columns.

deliver.shape: table: source | gemini says | page says | url | agree/differ

tasks.done_when: Every source in Gemini's spec checked.
rejected_if: a row copied from another row with the names changed
a source URL that does not open or does not say what the row claims
fewer items than the count
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
